scope: 134 native photographed samples from the 2015 Commons original and two independent December stations. Includes arch edges, finials, arch and leaf iron, both shaft frames, lamp colour, the address plaque and civic notice. Matched radii were set at 4–9 native pixels before inspecting the joined meshes.
residuals: All misses are retained. The outer arch, narrow mouldings and the lower diagonal of the open west leaf differ at some image samples. The three sources show a small opposite projective skew on each side of the piers. Local masonry remains plumb.
